quotes.text: We had a great experience. Everything was beyond our expectation. Our driver, Randy, picked us up right at our Airbnb. We've met wonderful people, tasted different sort of wines to please everyone and everything went smoothly. We never had any kind of pressure during the visits of the winery and the restaurant at the end of the tour was awesome. I strongly recommend it.

My wife and I had a great time sipping on wine from four great wineries. Doug with cellardoor tour made our experience even better. Very negligible of the area and all the wineries and wines. He kept all the wines purchased organized and easy to grab after our day. Well worth the money. A must do when visiting Niagara Falls

We had an excellent experience with this tour. Our guide - Dwight, was extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of wine growing in the region. The wineries were all outstanding and the dinner at the end of the day was absolutely delicious!

Had a fabulous experience on our wine tour. Karen ( OMG Karen, as we called her) was the best and really made it an exceptional day. She was most accommodating, lots of fun and took tons of photos that she shared.
The Cellar Door Dinner tour is an amazing experience. The ride was spacious and comfortable and our guide Dwight was incredibly knowledgeable and fun throughout the tour. Can’t recommend it enough!
Amazing! Our guide Karen, supported us so much. Every single vineyard is unique and overall experience was incredible. Highly recommend you experience!!!
Enjoyed a beautiful day and learned so much about Niagara area wine country. Our guide Tim was over the top informative and helpful!

We had a wonderful experience with Cellar Doors! The tour was well organized and a joy to attend. Karen, our tour guide, was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable of the area and professional. She ensured that the experience was interesting and entertaining from the moment we arrived until the moment we departed. She also took care of the little things such as packing our wines, taking pictures of the group, etc. Highly recommend Cellar Doors and Karen for a wine tours in NOTL. We look forward to returning soon!
